tagline: 美能达胶片相机，1966 年发布
description: 美能达于1966年推出的胶片相机。配备Rokkor 1:2.8/38mm with 4 elements。快门速度speed 1/90 sec. in normal or 1/40 sec. in flash mode。使用126 film cartridge。

specs.取景器: bright frame with parallax marks, distance symbols mirrored into finder, flash indicator
specs.快门: speed 1/90 sec. in normal or 1/40 sec. in flash mode
specs.闪光灯: X flash cubes, fired if needed
specs.英文简介: Compared to other cameras for Kodapak film the Minolta Autopak 500 has a quite fast lens.
